errors.name: NegativeStockError
errors.description: Raised when an attempt is made to set a wine's stock quantity to a negative value.

errors.name: LocationOverCapacityException
errors.description: Raised when adding a wine to a storage location would exceed that location's maximum bottle capacity.

errors.name: InvalidPricingException
errors.description: Raised when a wine's selling price is not strictly greater than its cost price.

errors.name: DuplicateWineNameError
errors.description: Raised when attempting to add a wine with a name that already exists in the system.

errors.name: StorageLocationNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a requested storage location is not found in the system.

errors.name: WineNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a requested wine is not found in the system.
